title: OpenSoha Proxy Runtime Message
description: Messages on the authenticated proxy runtime channel. Configuration content is delivered only to the enrolled runtime and is never returned by management reads.

capabilities.description: Advertise guarded_udp_v1 only after the real bounded datagram gate/transport/owned backend and current authorization enforcement are installed and verified; individual upstream protocols may remain TCP-only.

IPCIDR.description: Non-default IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR syntax. Core additionally validates canonical network-address bits and compressed address spelling with netip.

RuleMatcher.description: domain is case insensitive exact; domain_suffix matches label boundaries; cidr canonical netip prefix; process matching is local only, never trusted server-mandatory input. all has no value.

RuleAction.description: node/group require a logical targetId; reject/direct forbid targetId. ProtectedSet reject always wins.

EmployeeEndpoint.description: Operator approved internal endpoint; validate against approved endpoint set before delivery. HTTP CONNECT supports TCP only.

EmployeeCredential.description: Only delivered through scoped device mTLS channel with private/no-store caching; never administrator list/read response.

processEpoch.description: Endpoint-service boot nonce bound to the endpoint credential; not the epoch of an HA proxy server. The profile-scoped projection receipt must echo this exact nonce.

EmployeeProjection.description: Separate employee DTO. Safe aliases only; no upstream parameters/source URL. Fail closed on expiry, epoch change, unreachable internal endpoint. Never fetch direct source as fallback.

processEpoch.description: Exact endpoint-service boot nonce from the delivered projection, bound to endpoint credential; stale or mismatched echoes are rejected.

RuntimeCommandInput.description: Single typed bounded operation. Select requires groupId/nodeId; probe requires registered probeProfileId, never arbitrary URL. No controller path/body/shell. Expiry <=30 seconds; epoch must match.

RuntimeCommandResult.description: Bounded sanitized results; no raw kernel config/controller dumps or upstream secrets.

RuntimeCommandReceipt.description: Durable idempotent receipt; same requestId with different intent conflicts. Accepted does not mean applied. commandId equals requestId; durable uniqueness is scoped to (instanceID, requestId). Reuse by another actor or for a different intent returns conflict; no cross-actor receipt disclosure.

stopRequired.description: Optional, false omitted. True authorizes bounded confirmation that the exact owned engine and ingress have stopped, only under this newly issued controlRevision with acceptingRequests=false. Core issues a higher revision after the fixed drain expiry; confirmation expires within 30 seconds and no later than the original 240-second task deadline or certificate expiry. It never extends old-flow authorization or allows new traffic.

processStopped.description: Optional, false omitted. True proves the exact owned engine and ingress exited under the current stopRequired control revision, not merely a stopped Pod or a zero default. Requires explicit known activeConnections=0 and acceptingRequests=false. Old or late ACKs cannot confirm a newer revision; no positive proof means no scale-down.

ServerPublicationNode.description: Logical node and host-compiled outbound reference only. Never a caller-selected listener, controller path or upstream configuration.

ServerPublication.description: Server-runtime-only publication metadata, delivered with ConfigurationDesired. Real upstream remains in encrypted server configuration content; never send this DTO through employee/admin command results. The host independently compiles/validates outbound references and enforces lease, protection and ingress authorization.

BundleReadback.description: Authenticated real proxy runtime observation only. Core compares current desired/applied configuration revision/hash, bundle revision, process/member and credential identity. Caller flags alone never activate a bundle; reject stale, mismatched or unauthorized observations.

IngressCheckInput.description: Online authorization request from enrolled runtime. Core derives identity from real mTLS, resolves current user/device/profile/scope and rechecks bundle/node/epoch and destination protection. No caller field grants identity or authorization. Never log, audit, echo or include credentialSecret in errors. UDP is explicitly unsupported unless the verified ingress transport provides it; never silently convert to TCP or DIRECT.

IngressCheckResult.description: Scoped, short-lived decision, not a reusable grant. Revalidate active flows against current authorization; old epoch/lease cannot preserve revoked access. Denials/errors never expose credential or upstream values.
